title: Slow English Podcast - My BUS STORIES🚐

header.titleZh: 慢速英語podcast - 我的巴士故事🚐
header.titleEn: Slow English Podcast - My BUS STORIES🚐

sentences.en: Hello, welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
sentences.tc: 你好，歡迎回到我的慢速英文podcast。

englishTokens.text: Hello,
welcome back
to my
Slow English podcast

sentences.en: Today I want to talk to you about a story I saw the other day while I was riding on the bus.
sentences.tc: 今天我想跟大家講一個我前幾天坐公車時看到的故事。

englishTokens.text: Today I want to talk to you about a story I saw the other day while I was riding on the bus.

sentences.en: I was riding on the bus with my mom.
sentences.tc: 我和媽媽一起搭公車。

englishTokens.text: I was riding on the bus with my mom.

sentences.en: We were going to Starbucks to work.
sentences.tc: 我們要去星巴克上班。

englishTokens.text: We were going to Starbucks to work.

sentences.en: On the bus, there was a little girl, maybe around four or five years old.
sentences.tc: 公車上有個小女孩，大概四、五歲左右。

englishTokens.text: On the bus, there was a little girl, maybe around four or five years old.

sentences.en: She looked very sweet.
sentences.tc: 她看起來很可愛。

englishTokens.text: She looked very sweet.

sentences.en: She was dressed in pink from head to toe, and she was with her mother.
sentences.tc: 她從頭到腳都穿著粉紅色的衣服，和媽媽在一起。

englishTokens.text: She was dressed in pink from head to toe, and she was with her mother.

sentences.en: She was playing games and laughing with her mother.
sentences.tc: 她正在和媽媽玩遊戲，笑著。

englishTokens.text: She was playing games and laughing with her mother.

sentences.en: But then the mother had to leave.
sentences.tc: 但後來母親不得不離開。

englishTokens.text: But then the mother had to leave.

sentences.en: She had to stop and get off for work.
sentences.tc: 她必須停下來下車去上班。

englishTokens.text: She had to stop and
get
off for work.

sentences.en: So her mother handed over her daughter to her grandpa, and the little girl started crying and crying her eyes out.
sentences.tc: 於是她媽媽把女兒交給了爺爺，小女孩哭了起來，哭得眼睛都腫了。

englishTokens.text: So her mother handed over her daughter to her grandpa, and the little girl started crying and crying her eyes out.

sentences.en: She didn't want her mom to leave.
sentences.tc: 她不想讓媽媽離開。

englishTokens.text: She didn't want her mom to leave.

sentences.en: But eventually, the little girl was carried away by her grandpa.
sentences.tc: 但最終，小女孩被爺爺抱走了。

englishTokens.text: But eventually, the little girl was carried away by her grandpa.

sentences.en: She said bye to her mom, and she left.
sentences.tc: 她向媽媽說了再見，然後就離開了。

englishTokens.text: She said bye to her mom, and she left.

sentences.en: It reminded me of when I was a little girl, and I could sympathize with the feeling of missing your mom so much.
sentences.tc: 這讓我想起了我還是個小女孩的時候，我很同情你如此想念你媽媽的感覺。

englishTokens.text: It reminded me of when I was a little girl, and I could sympathize with the feeling of missing your mom so much.

sentences.en: When your mom is literally the whole world for you, when you are a little girl, that is the feeling you have.
sentences.tc: 當你還是個小女孩時，當你的媽媽對你來說就是整個世界時，這就是你的感覺。

englishTokens.text: When your mom is literally the whole world for you, when you are a little girl, that is the feeling you have.

sentences.en: You can't go even a few hours without your mom, let alone a whole day without your mom.
sentences.tc: 你連幾個小時都不能離開你的媽媽，更別說一整天都沒有你的媽媽了。

englishTokens.text: You can't go even a few hours without your mom, let alone a whole day without your mom.

sentences.en: So you just miss her and think about her all day long.
sentences.tc: 所以你只是想念她，整天想著她。

englishTokens.text: So you just miss her and think about her all day long.

sentences.en: It made me tear up a little bit on the bus because it reminded me of when I was a little girl.
sentences.tc: 這讓我在公車上流下了一點眼淚，因為它讓我想起了我還是個小女孩的時候。

englishTokens.text: It
made
me tear up a little bit on the bus because it reminded me of when I was a little girl.

sentences.en: It reminded me of how fast we all grow up.
sentences.tc: 它讓我想起我們都成長得有多快。

englishTokens.text: It reminded me of how fast we all grow up.

sentences.en: One day you're crying because your mom went to work.
sentences.tc: 有一天，你因為媽媽去上班而哭了。

englishTokens.text: One day you're crying because your mom went to work.

sentences.en: The next day, you don't think about your mom for days or maybe even weeks.
sentences.tc: 第二天，你幾天甚至幾週都不會想起你的媽媽。

englishTokens.text: The next day, you don't think about your mom for days or maybe even weeks.

sentences.en: Our parents grow up so fast, and we grow up even faster.
sentences.tc: 我們的父母長大得很快，我們也長大得更快。

englishTokens.text: Our parents grow up so fast, and we grow up even faster.

sentences.en: Before you know it, we're all grown-ups living our own lives.
sentences.tc: 在你意識到之前，我們都是成年人，過著自己的生活。

englishTokens.text: Before you know it, we're all grown-ups living our own lives.

sentences.en: I'm sure every mom remembers when their daughters would cry or their sons would cry when they had to leave for work.
sentences.tc: 我相信每個媽媽都記得當他們必須去上班時，他們的女兒會哭泣，或者他們的兒子會哭泣。

englishTokens.text: I'm sure every mom remembers when their daughters would cry or their sons would cry when they had to leave for work.

sentences.en: Sometimes I wish I could go back to the days where my only worry was, "When is Mom coming home?"
sentences.tc: 有時候我真希望能回到以前唯一擔心的是「媽媽什麼時候回家？」的日子。

englishTokens.text: Sometimes I wish I could go back to the days where my only worry was, "When is Mom coming home?"

sentences.en: Let me know if you enjoyed this bus story.
sentences.tc: 如果您喜歡這個巴士故事，請告訴我。

englishTokens.text: Let me know
if you enjoyed this bus story.

sentences.en: This is a more advanced-level story, but it's something I enjoy speaking about with you guys.
sentences.tc: 這是一個更高級的故事，但我喜歡和你們談論它。

englishTokens.text: This is a more
advanced
-level story, but it's something I enjoy speaking about with you guys.

sentences.en: Let me know in the comments if you have any nice bus stories you would like to share.
sentences.tc: 如果您有任何精彩的巴士故事想分享，請在評論中告訴我。

englishTokens.text: Let me know
in the comments if you have any nice bus stories you would like to share.

examples.en: __Let me know__ if you enjoyed this bus story.

usages.usage: 表示使某人產生某種感受或狀態
examples: It 《made》 me tear up a little bit on the bus because it reminded me of when I was a little girl.

usages.usage: 在 get ready/get lost 等搭配中表示「變得、進入某狀態」
examples: She had to stop and 《get》 off for work.

breakdowns.sentence: Hello, welcome back to my Slow English podcast.
breakdowns.translation: 你好，歡迎回到我的慢速英文podcast。

points.label: to 不定詞
points.note: 用來表示目的、補語或接在特定動詞後。

breakdowns.sentence: Today I want to talk to you about a story I saw the other day while I was riding on the bus.
breakdowns.translation: 今天我想跟大家講一個我前幾天坐公車時看到的故事。

points.label: while + V-ing / 子句
points.note: 表示兩個動作同時發生。

breakdowns.sentence: It reminded me of when I was a little girl, and I could sympathize with the feeling of missing your mom so much.
breakdowns.translation: 這讓我想起了我還是個小女孩的時候，我很同情你如此想念你媽媽的感覺。

points.label: when 時間子句
points.note: 用 when 說明事情發生的時間或情境。

breakdowns.sentence: When your mom is literally the whole world for you, when you are a little girl, that is the feeling you have.
breakdowns.translation: 當你還是個小女孩時，當你的媽媽對你來說就是整個世界時，這就是你的感覺。

points.label: that 引導名詞子句或關係子句
points.note: that 用來補充說明前面的想法或名詞。

breakdowns.sentence: I'm sure every mom remembers when their daughters would cry or their sons would cry when they had to leave for work.
breakdowns.translation: 我相信每個媽媽都記得當他們必須去上班時，他們的女兒會哭泣，或者他們的兒子會哭泣。

points.label: would 表示假設或委婉語氣
points.note: 用來談假設、過去習慣或較委婉的說法。

breakdowns.sentence: Let me know if you enjoyed this bus story.
breakdowns.translation: 如果您喜歡這個巴士故事，請告訴我。

points.label: if 條件句
points.note: 用 if 帶出條件，再說明在此條件下的結果。
